initial_findings.summary: Recovery checks could report RECOVERY_READONLY_CHECKS_COMPLETE while accounts-readonly or api-connections-readonly returned integration_failure.

fix.summary: Gate recovery success on originalOk, customOk, accountsOk, and apiOk. Preserve accounts_readonly_ok and api_readonly_ok booleans in the machine packet.

final_reaudit.summary: Re-audit confirmed the false-green blocker is fixed. Recovery success now requires originalOk, customOk, accountsOk, and apiOk; accounts/API integration_failure now blocks. No new forbidden browser fields, ~/.codex references, custom recovery backend route, kill, or rollback calls found in touched files.
